asset.name: ArtifactReviewFlow
asset.description: The generated-output workflow for preview, comparison, editing, commenting, approval, revision request, versioning, export, and application of accepted changes.

requires.reason: Artifact identity, versions, and actions are shared.
Change review, partial selection, and approval are shared.
Applying changes over a moved target reconciles through the shared flow.

signatureMoment.description: Accepting part of a proposal applies exactly what was selected and leaves the rest visibly pending, so review is incremental rather than all-or-nothing.
